title: 5 Warning Signs Before You Buy a Used Truck in 2027 (2.45 Million Odometers Rolled Back)
description:
Five warning signs to check before buying a used truck in 2027: rolled-back odometers, unfixed recalls, flood damage, title problems and prices. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:48 1. Mileage that does not add up
5:13 2. Flood damage
9:09 3. Unfixed recalls
12:22 4. Hard use with no records
14:55 5. Known engines and the cold start
17:31 Bonus: accident history
18:32 Used truck checklist for 2027

Sources:
- S&P Global Mobility / Carfax, odometer rollbacks reach 2.45 million vehicles (Dec 2025): https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/s-p-global-carfax-odometer-rollbacks-see-dramatic-jump-of-14-to-2-45-million-vehicles-20251216
- Carrier Management (Oct 13, 2026): https://www.carriermanagement.com/news/2026/10/13/292656.htm
- Business Wire (Jan 30, 2026): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260130930477/en
- Vehicle Remarketing, pickup trucks see stable prices: https://www.vehicleremarket.com/news/pickup-trucks-see-stable-prices
- S&P Global, Carfax: backup camera recalls surge: https://aftermarketinsight.spglobal.com/news/5390/carfax-says-backup-camera-recalls-surge-as-nearly-7-million-vehicles-remain-unfixed
- CBT News, 7 million unfixed backup camera recalls: https://www.cbtnews.com/carfax-7-million-unfixed-backup-camera-recalls/
- FOX 26 Houston, 1 in 5 vehicles have an unresolved recall: https://www.fox26houston.com/news/1-5-vehicles-us-roads-unresolved-recall-how-to-check
- Digital Dealer, Carfax free recall search: https://digitaldealer.com/news/carfax-free-recall-search-service-tops-10-billion-checks-nationwide/169561/
